title: Yonge & Roselawn Towers in Midtown Rising Above Expansive Podium
summary:
Yonge & Roselawn’s future 25- and 31-storey residential rental towers are beginning to rise from an expansive mixed-use podium on Yonge north of Eglinton in Toronto's Midtown area. The Hariri Pontarini Architects-designed development sits about a 450m walk from Eglinton station, connecting future residents to both Yonge Line 1 and the Eglinton Line 5.
